name: Run test case

on:
    push:
    pull_request:
    release:
        types:
            - published
            - prereleased

jobs:

    run_test_case:

        runs-on: ubuntu-latest
        strategy:
            fail-fast: false
            matrix:
                docker_image:
                  - "ghcr.io/emqx/emqx-builder/5.5-2:1.18.3-27.2-3-ubuntu24.04"

        steps:
        - name: Checkout
          uses: actions/checkout@v4
          with:
            submodules: recursive
        - name: work around https://github.com/actions/checkout/issues/766
          run: git config --global --add safe.directory "${GITHUB_WORKSPACE}"
        - name: Run tests
          env:
            DOCKER_IMAGE: "${{ matrix.docker_image }}"
          shell: bash
          run: |
            set -e
            docker build -t testimage --build-arg BUILD_FROM=${DOCKER_IMAGE} -f Dockerfile.test .
            docker network create --ipv6 --subnet 2001:0DB8::/112 testnet
            docker run -d --net testnet --name testcontainer testimage bash -c "tail -f /dev/null"
            # The CT suites run against an EMQX container that shares the
            # network namespace of the test container.
            CT_BROKER_NETWORK=container:testcontainer scripts/ct-broker.sh up
            docker exec testcontainer bash -c 'make eunit'
            docker exec testcontainer bash -c 'make ct CT_BROKER=external'
            docker exec testcontainer bash -c 'make cover'
            # @TODO rebar3 tar does not include appup of dep apps
            # docker exec testcontainer bash -c 'make relup-test'
            # copy the build dir to host working dir for following build steps
            docker cp testcontainer:/_w/_build .
            scripts/ct-broker.sh down
            docker rm -f testcontainer
        - name: EMQX logs
          if: failure()
          run: docker logs emqtt-ct-emqx || true
        - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
          if: always()
          with:
            name: logs
            path: _build/test/logs
        - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
          with:
            name: cover
            path: _build/test/cover

name: Checks

on:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
